svg.title: S&P 500 futures as the September 11 attacks unfolded
svg.desc: Approximate tracing of the lecture reproduction of Siegel (2008), Figure 13-1. Between 08:43 and 09:15, futures initially fall and recover, then drop steeply around the second impact at 09:03. The sharp fluctuations and partial rebound are retained. Event times are from the 9/11 Commission.
